definitions.explanation: The state of being infected with or having a condition while displaying no symptoms. The prefix {無|む}〜 means "without."

examples.japanese: {無症状|むしょうじょう}の{患者|かんじゃ}。
{感染|かんせん}しても{無症状|むしょうじょう}のことがある。
examples.english: One can be infected yet show no symptoms.

examples.japanese: {無症状|むしょうじょう}の{人|ひと}でも{他人|たにん}にうつす{可能性|かのうせい}がある。
examples.english: Even asymptomatic people can pass the infection to others.

notes:
Medical term, used as a noun and with の ({無症状|むしょうじょう}の{感染者|かんせんしゃ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無症状|むしょうじょう}{感染者|かんせんしゃ}: asymptomatic carrier
- {無症状|むしょうじょう}のまま: while remaining symptom-free

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {軽症|けいしょう}: mild case — has symptoms, but light
- {発症|はっしょう}する: to develop symptoms — the opposite event
